caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, knee-length coat that is primarily deep violet or purple in color, rendered with textured shading to suggest a velvety fabric. The coat features two vertical rows of decorative round buttons, each row containing eight buttons, running parallel down the front. The coat is fitted at the shoulders and widens slightly toward the hem. There are two outward-pointing, triangular flaps at hip level, likely representing pockets. The collar is white, wide, and scalloped with embroidered floral cutout patterns. On the upper left and right corners of the drawing, there are two smaller sketches: the left one shows a detailed round emblem or button labeled "Detail of Buttons," and the right one presents the "Back View" of the coat, giving a simple outline with notations for the placement of seams and pockets. The coat is displayed on a plain, uncolored background. The artist's signature, "Mary Haines," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Child's Coat
